accepted.novelty: Explicit alternating human turn procedure. First-player/clockwise/single-turn order is a distinct procedural rule with consequential placement priority, not new arithmetic or another instance of the ordinary occupancy rule. The skip-after-Reveal clause is already covered in Q03 and is included only to make the procedure complete; it is not counted as new coverage.

Adds the ordinary untied resolution branch, not another arithmetic instance of the tie rules. A response could satisfy every existing required tie/Rival answer while never stating who wins an untied Conflict or that the second-highest player receives the second reward. The three-player cutoff is also not required by Q11’s four-player scenario. Four-player third place and zero-strength clauses are contextual reinforcement, not claimed as additional novelty.
